name: minv
description: VS Code, cut down to reading, Markdown, changes, commits and branches.

scripts.compile: node scripts/fork-prepare.mjs && cd .upstream/build && pnpm run compile-client && pnpm run electron
scripts.build: node scripts/fork-prepare.mjs && BUILD_SOURCEVERSION=$(git rev-parse HEAD) pnpm -C .upstream/build run gulp vscode-linux-x64-min
